user.title: Set up Nursery Soother
user.description: Select the nursery devices, white-noise audio, and at least one Home Assistant Companion App notification action.

data_description.white_noise: Choose an audio item that Home Assistant can play on the selected media player.
data_description.notify_targets: Enter one or more registered actions such as notify.mobile_app_parent_phone.

behavior.title: Configure soothing behavior
behavior.description: Choose conservative volume limits and response timings. Nursery Soother starts disabled.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Nursery Soother
reconfigure.description: Update the nursery devices, white-noise audio, or parent notification actions.

data_description.white_noise: Choose an audio item that Home Assistant can play on the selected media player.
data_description.notify_targets: Enter one or more registered actions such as notify.mobile_app_parent_phone.

abort.devices_already_configured: One or more selected nursery devices were assigned to another entry while setup was in progress. Start setup again with different devices.

error.invalid_entity: The selected entity does not exist.
error.invalid_entity_domain: The selected entity has the wrong type.
error.entity_already_configured: This entity is already assigned to another Nursery Soother entry.
error.unsupported_media_player: The selected media player must support playing media, setting its volume, and stopping or pausing playback.
error.notify_targets_required: Select at least one parent notification action.
error.invalid_notify_action: Each notification action must use the format notify.mobile_app_device_name.
error.invalid_audio_media: Select an audio item for white-noise playback.
error.invalid_local_audio_media: Select white-noise audio from Home Assistant's My media library.
error.notify_action_not_found: One or more notification actions are not registered in Home Assistant.
error.invalid_volume_configuration: Volumes must satisfy 0% ≤ baseline ≤ boost ≤ maximum ≤ 100%.
error.positive_integer_required: Enter a whole number of seconds greater than zero.

init.title: Configure soothing behavior
init.description: Update volume limits and response timings. Changing these settings does not enable or disable Nursery Soother.

error.invalid_volume_configuration: Volumes must satisfy 0% ≤ baseline ≤ boost ≤ maximum ≤ 100%.

invalid_entity.message: The configured {config_key} must be a valid entity ID.

invalid_entity_domain.message: The configured {config_key} must be a {expected_domain} entity.

invalid_options.message: The stored volume or timer settings are invalid. Reconfigure Nursery Soother.

invalid_configuration.message: The stored white-noise media or parent notification configuration is invalid. Reconfigure Nursery Soother.

duplicate_devices.message: One or more nursery devices are already assigned to another Nursery Soother entry. Reconfigure this entry with different devices.

not_configured.message: Nursery Soother needs white-noise audio and at least one parent notification action before it can be enabled.

not_loaded.message: Nursery Soother is not loaded. Reload its config entry before using this control.

invalid_volume.message: Volumes must satisfy 0% ≤ baseline ≤ boost ≤ maximum ≤ 100%.

devices_unavailable.message: One or more configured nursery devices are unavailable.

playback_replaced.message: The nursery speaker is playing different media. Stop Nursery Soother and enable it again before using this control.

playback_settling.message: Home Assistant is still waiting for a previous speaker command to settle. Try enabling Nursery Soother again in a few seconds.
